name: Sentence-Structured Typography Line Breaks
use_when: Caption, title, or graphic text wraps awkwardly.
The viewer has to reassemble the sentence because line breaks split meaning.
A text card, subtitle, or lower third needs cleaner phrase structure.
avoid_when: The exact line break is required by a legal, lyric, quote, or accessibility constraint.
The text is too long and should be rewritten instead of line-broken.
The layout relies on decorative wrapping that damages comprehension.

timeline_pattern.pattern: raw_text -> remove_filler_if_allowed -> find_phrase_units -> break_lines_by_thought -> check_screen_area -> time_to_speech -> qc
timeline_pattern.phrase_rule: Each line should read as a complete phrase or thought whenever possible.
timeline_pattern.poetry_rule: Treat short video text like a spoken line: the break should help rhythm and comprehension.
timeline_pattern.orphan_rule: Avoid leaving weak filler words alone as the emphasized or final line.
timeline_pattern.rewrite_rule: If every line break feels bad, shorten the text instead of forcing the layout.

motion.rule: Reveal line by line only when it matches reading order; avoid staggered animation that makes the sentence harder to parse.

keyframe_values.caption_lines: Prefer one line when the frame already contains visual text; use two compact lines when the phrase needs it.
keyframe_values.hold: Hold phrase-complete text long enough to read at delivery size before clearing.

sound.rule: Line breaks should follow spoken rhythm; do not let music or SFX force confusing text timing.

captions.rule: Correct auto-caption line breaks manually; chunk by meaning, breath, and screen safety rather than raw character count alone.

color.rule: Line structure should be readable before color emphasis is added.

implementation.ffmpeg: Insert explicit line breaks in drawtext text files or ASS subtitles and preview at final resolution.
implementation.remotion: Store text as phraseLines arrays instead of relying on browser auto-wrap for important captions or titles.
implementation.blender: Use separate text objects or manual line breaks so spacing and alignment can be controlled.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Edit auto-caption line breaks manually and split text layers when hierarchy requires separate lines.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Correct generated caption chunks and Essential Graphics text line breaks before applying styles or converting to graphics.

common_mistakes: Trusting automatic wrapping on hook text.
Splitting a phrase so the important word lands on a confusing line.
Emphasizing a filler word because it became isolated by the line break.
Animating each line in an order that fights speech rhythm.
qc: Does each line read as a phrase or clean thought?
Are filler words prevented from becoming visual emphasis?
Does the text fit the safe area without covering key visuals?
Is the line break checked after applying font, size, tracking, and motion?
